signup.title: Creating your account
items: Choose "Worker" if you want clients to find and call you for jobs. Choose "Client" if you are looking for someone to hire.
Use your real name - it is what other people will see.
Workers: after signing up you will be asked for your profession, where you work and your ID. Clients: you can browse right away.

login.title: Logging in
items: Use the same email and password (or Google account) you signed up with.
No account yet? Use the link below to sign up - it takes a minute.

completeProfile.title: One last step
items: Tell us whether you are a worker or a client and add your name and phone number.
Your role can't be changed later, so choose carefully.

dashboardClient.title: Your dashboard
items: Browsing workers is free. You pay only to see phone numbers: 50 EGP unlocks up to 5 visit workers for 3 days, and 2,000 EGP unlocks up to 10 monthly workers for one month.
Below you can see your subscription: how many workers you have unlocked and until when it lasts.
Tap "Browse workers" to find someone, or "My subscription" to see the numbers you already unlocked.

dashboardWorker.title: Your dashboard
items: This is a summary of your listing. Clients see your name, profession, locations and prices - never your ID.

Your listing only appears to clients once an admin approves your ID AND it is complete: your phone number, where you live and work, at least one priced task and, if you work by visits, a neighborhood. Your dashboard shows a checklist of what is missing.
Use "Manage my listing" to change your prices, locations, availability and phone number.

dashboardAdmin.title: Admin dashboard
items: Pending worker reviews: workers waiting for you to check their ID and approve them.
Pending payments: clients who sent 2,000 EGP and are waiting for you to confirm it so their month starts.
Open the admin panel to work through both queues.

workerOnboarding.title: Setting up your worker profile
items: Choose your main profession, for example Driver or Plumber. Later you can add other professions too and price the tasks for each.
Say whether you work by the month, by visits, or both. Clients can filter for either.
If you work by visits, add the neighborhoods you visit (for example Maadi or Nasr City). Nearby clients search by neighborhood, so this is how they find you.
Choose the governorate you live in, and every governorate you are willing to work in. At least one is required - clients only contact workers who serve their area.
Upload a clear photo of your national ID or residency permit. Only the admin reviewing your account can ever see it.
A profile photo is optional but helps clients trust you.
Turn on notifications on your dashboard so your phone buzzes when a client asks if you're available.

Important: when a client wants your number, you will get a question on your dashboard "Are you available?" and must answer within 24 hours. We also ask every 2 weeks if you are still available. Check the app regularly.
After you submit, an admin reviews your ID. You will see the result the next time you log in.

workerPending.title: What happens now
items: An admin is checking your ID. There is nothing else you need to do.
Log in again later - once you are approved you can add your tasks and prices, and clients will be able to find you.

workerRejected.title: What to do next
items: Read the reason above. The most common reasons are an unclear ID photo or details that don't match.
Contact the Khedma team if you think this was a mistake.

workerListing.title: How your listing works
items: Professions: you can offer more than one, for example a cleaner who also drives. Add them in "Your professions", then price each profession's tasks below. Your main profession can't be removed.
How you work: tick monthly, visits or both. Clients can filter for workers who work by the month or who come for visits.
Neighborhoods: if you work by visits, list the neighborhoods you visit. Nearby clients search by neighborhood, and you won't appear in the Visits tab without at least one.
Locations: clients filter by governorate, so list every place you really work. You always need at least one.
What you offer: add each task with a price. You can add the same task twice, for example one price for homes and another for businesses.
Availability: switch to "unavailable" when you are fully booked. Clients still see you but know not to expect an answer.
Contact phone: clients only see this number after paying to unlock you - keep it correct and keep your phone on.

Client questions: when a client wants your number, a green box appears at the top of this page asking if you are available. Answer within 24 hours. A client only gets your number if you say yes. If you don't answer, it counts against you.

Every 2 weeks you will be asked if you are still available, and every 3 months to confirm your details and that you are still available. If you don't, your listing is hidden from clients until you do. It is also hidden if clients report your number doesn't work or that you aren't looking for work.
Deleting your profile removes you from Khedma completely.

browseClient.title: How to find a worker
items: Use the tabs at the top to choose: Monthly (a worker who works for you by the month, like a driver, cook or nanny) or Visits (someone who comes for a job, like a plumber or electrician).
Use the filters to narrow the list - especially the governorate, so you only see workers who work in your area.
Each card shows where the worker lives, where they work, what they offer and their prices.

To contact a worker, first tap "Check availability". It is free: we ask the worker, and they have 24 hours to say yes or no. If they say yes you can unlock them; if not, nothing is spent and you can pick someone else.
Unlock contact uses one of your 10 slots and shows the phone number until your month ends. Call or message them yourself.
A few days after unlocking, we will ask you how it went. Please answer - it keeps the list honest for everyone.

If a number doesn't work, or the worker says they aren't looking or already found a job, tap "Report a problem" under their number. We ask the worker to confirm their details, and hide them from everyone if several clients report the same worker.
Colours help you remember: green = unlocked now, orange = unlocked in an earlier month, blue = you looked at them but never unlocked, white = new to you.
Use the "Show" filter to see only workers you haven't seen yet.

browseViewer.title: What you are looking at
items: This is the list clients see when they search for workers.
Phone numbers are hidden - only clients who have paid and unlocked a worker can see them.

subscribe.title: How to pay
items: Send the exact amount shown below to the number below using Instapay or Vodafone Cash: 50 EGP for the visits pass, 2,000 EGP for the monthly plan.
Take a screenshot of the confirmation, choose the method you used, upload the screenshot and press Submit.
An admin checks it and starts your month. You will see the status on this page when you log in again.

paymentPending.title: What happens now
items: An admin is checking your screenshot. You don't need to pay again or send it again.
Once approved, you can unlock up to 10 workers for one month.

mySubscription.title: Your subscription
items: This lists every worker you unlocked, with their phone number, for each plan you have: the visits pass (3 days) and the monthly plan (1 month).
On the expiry date everything locks again, even workers you unlocked. Subscribe again to unlock new ones.
Workers you unlocked before are flagged on the Browse page so you don't spend a slot on them twice by accident.

adminWorkers.title: Reviewing workers
items: Open the ID and check the photo is clear and the details match the profile.
Check the locations make sense. Approve to make the worker visible to clients, or reject and give a reason the worker will see.

plans.title: Which plan do I need?
items: Visits pass (50 EGP): for workers who come for a visit or job - plumbers, electricians, technicians, one-off cleaning. You can unlock 5 workers within 3 days.
Monthly plan (2,000 EGP): for workers who work for you by the month - drivers, cooks, nannies, housekeepers. You can unlock 10 workers within one month.
Each plan only unlocks the matching kind of worker. You can buy both at the same time.

adminFlagged.title: Flagged workers
items: These workers had bad experiences with clients: no reply to an availability check, a wrong number, or not available.
Two different clients since the worker last confirmed, or three in 90 days, hides the worker from clients.
Contact the worker to find out what happened. Press "Clear flags" only once you are satisfied, so a worker can't erase their own record.

adminPayments.title: Confirming payments
items: Open the screenshot and check the amount matches the plan shown (50 EGP for a visits pass, 2,000 EGP for a monthly plan) and that the money reached your Instapay or Vodafone Cash.
Approve to start the client's month with 10 unlock slots. Reject with a reason if something is wrong.

download.title: Download the Khedma Android app
download.subtitle: This installs Khedma as an app on your Android phone, without using the Google Play Store.
download.step1: Tap the download button above. Your phone may warn you this file isn't from the Play Store - that's expected.
download.step2: Open the downloaded file. If asked, allow your browser to "install unknown apps."
download.step3: Tap Install, then open Khedma from your home screen.
download.note: Khedma will always show the latest version of the website - you'll only need to download this again if we specifically ask you to.
